PRIVACY

Privacy &
camera data.

Private draft · policy configuration required

This overview describes the current implementation. The operator details, retention rules, and final privacy policy must be confirmed before public launch.

On this website

This draft website does not request camera access, collect signups, or use added analytics, advertising trackers, or browser storage. Its host may process ordinary request information, including IP addresses, to deliver and protect the site. The private draft is protected by the hosting platform’s access controls.

Camera in the mobile game

Flap Fit uses the front camera during a game to estimate body landmarks and turn movement into bird movement. The current game processes video live on the device; it does not record, save, or upload camera video. Audio is not requested by the game’s camera flow.

Camera access requires permission. You can change that permission in your phone settings.

Tracking downloads

The game downloads its MediaPipe tracking engine and pose model from jsDelivr and Google’s model storage. These services may receive ordinary connection information, such as an IP address. Camera frames are not part of those download requests.

Progress and competitive play

Your selected bird, training history, scores, and level progress are stored locally on your phone. Online leaderboards and challenges can send your chosen player name, device identifier, exercise, challenge code, target, and score to the game service. Names, scores, and challenge results may be visible to other players using those features. Camera video is not included.

Tracked training time describes active gameplay. It does not certify exercise form or physiological time under tension.

Contact and data requests

A privacy contact is not yet configured for this private draft. A working contact and request process must be added before launch.

Requests concerning locally stored progress and server-held competitive data need separate instructions. Retention periods, deletion handling, service providers, and applicable regional rights are awaiting operator confirmation.
